say:1:1521121001:1.text: ... Even here in Wrathwood Grove, <style="highlight">Halia's wheat refuses to grow</style>.

say:2:1521121002:1.text: I've heard that every god commands a different domain.
say:2:1521121002:1.source_cn: 老朽曾听闻，每位神明都执掌着不同的权能。

say:3:1521121003:1.text: The God of Harvest... he governed all crop growth. If that mage Merlin was right, then it makes sense the seeds won't grow!
say:3:1521121003:1.source_cn: 丰饶神……作物的生长和成熟都归属于他的权柄。若真如那名...

say:4:1521121004:1.text: Even the Herdmaster's blessed holy water couldn't break the curse. That can't be good...
say:4:1521121004:1.source_cn: 不过，神堕对麦种的影响无法被兽群之主恩赐的纯净圣水消除...
say:4:1521121004:1.male: Even the Herdmaster's blessed holy water couldn't break the curse. That can't be good...
say:4:1521121004:1.female: Even the Herdmaster's blessed holy water couldn't break the curse. That can't be good...

say:5:1521121005:1.text: There goes the plan to end this war with wheat...
say:5:1521121005:1.source_cn: 那么，用小麦劝降呼临城……恐怕无法实现。

choice_prompt:6:1521121005.text: There goes the plan to end this war with wheat...
choice_prompt:6:1521121005.source_cn: 那么，用小麦劝降呼临城……恐怕无法实现。

say:9:1521121007:1.text: Oh... you... you'd really go that far? You'd fight another god to protect the Wildborn and stop Halia?!
say:9:1521121007:1.source_cn: 噢噢……您、您竟然愿意为了庇护雅库伯尔、阻止呼临人再进...
say:9:1521121007:1.male: Oh... you... you'd really go that far? You'd fight another god to protect the Wildborn and stop Halia?!
say:9:1521121007:1.female: Oh... you... you'd really go that far? You'd fight another god to protect the Wildborn and stop Halia?!

say:10:1521121008:1.text: How did we ever earn the favor of a god like you?
say:10:1521121008:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔何德何能，得到您这样伟大的神明庇护！
say:10:1521121008:1.male: How did we ever earn the favor of a god like you?
say:10:1521121008:1.female: How did we ever earn the favor of a goddess like you?

say:11:1521121009:1.text: O mighty Wild Moon! I, Modra, swear again: with all my heart and soul, I pledge myself to you—my life, my loyalty, all of it—to see your divine will done!
say:11:1521121009:1.source_cn: 伟大的雅库伯尔之月！我，蒙多，再次向您宣誓——必将全心...
say:11:1521121009:1.male: O mighty Wild Moon! I, Modra, swear again: with all my heart and soul, I pledge myself to you—my life, my loyalty, all of it—to see your divine will done!
say:11:1521121009:1.female: O mighty Wild Moon! I, Modra, swear again: with all my heart and soul, I pledge myself to you—my life, my loyalty, all of it—to see your divine will done!

say:12:1521121010:0.text: Me too... I'll give everything for you, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:12:1521121010:0.male: Me too... I'll give everything for you, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:12:1521121010:0.female: Me too... I'll give everything for you, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:13:1521121011:1.text: May the Wildborn forever bask in your grace!
say:13:1521121011:1.source_cn: 神啊，愿雅库伯尔永远沐浴在您的荣光之中！
say:13:1521121011:1.male: May the Wildborn forever bask in your grace!
say:13:1521121011:1.female: May the Wildborn forever bask in your grace!

say:15:1521121012:1.text: Modra's praise rings in your ears, but your mind has already drifted somewhere else.
say:15:1521121012:1.source_cn: 蒙多的赞颂声萦绕在你耳边，但你早已无心去听。

say:16:1521121013:1.text: If Halia's wheat was cursed by a fallen god, what about the wheat you brought from the far future?
say:16:1521121013:1.source_cn: 如果呼临城的麦种是因神堕诅咒而无法生长，那么你从万年后...

say:17:1521121014:1.text: You'd love to try planting it, to see if it's any different. But you can't, not now. You need that wheat. It's your only ticket home.
say:17:1521121014:1.source_cn: 你很想试着种植它，但眼下，它是你返回未来时空的唯一途径……

say:18:1521121015:1.text: A few tiny seeds... maybe they could bring peace to Halia and the Wildborn. But not yet.
say:18:1521121015:1.source_cn: 几粒小小的种子，或许便能为呼临城和雅库伯尔带来珍贵的和...

say:19:1521121016:1.text: You'll wait, until Merlin the First finds a way to send you back to the future.
say:19:1521121016:1.source_cn: 等到初代梅林找出送你返回未来的方法之后，或许你会有机会...

say:20:1521121017:1.text: ... And hopefully, that day isn't too far off.

choice:6:0:1.text: We're left with Merlin's final plan.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 想停止战争，只有梅林说的办法了
choice:6:0:1.male: We're left with Merlin's final plan.
choice:6:0:1.female: We're left with Merlin's final plan.
